name: LocalizationTable
src_typeComment: A whole translation sheet in memory: the locale codes across the top, the keys down the side, and the text in between. Kept as a plain data holder so the CSV shape and the asset shape never have to know about each other — the importer, the exporter and the runtime file loader all meet here.
